name: Scopa MR
summary:
**Scopa MR brings Scopa, Italy's most beloved card game, into your real space.**

Put on your headset: a green card table appears in your living room, your garden or on the beach, and your virtual opponent takes a seat across from you, ready for a challenge.

**How to play**
Capture cards from the table with a card of the same value, or with a combination that adds up to it. Clear the whole table and score a **scopa**! Every move is announced and explained on screen, so even first-time players learn in minu
